senses.definition: In the liturgical use of the Tanakh, a fixed substitution that is always expected when a certain written word is read out, most notably אֲדוֹנָי (ăḏônāy, literally “my Lord(s)”) for יהוה (YHVH), the name of God; an indication of such a substitution.
A large river in northwestern Iran. It originates from the mountains of Kurdistan and discharges to the Caspian Sea.
